name: SD: SaaS growth (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A SaaS business's dashboard, every day: the ad budget left, active visitors, trials, paying customers and cancelled customers. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the business (the ground truth is in sd-saas/truth.model.json, including a stock the dashboard does not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
